lead_html:
RM_WaterThin, ruling D4 (by card 2026-10-16). The one new texture of the pond-depth design (§4): depth 1, ankle-deep still water with the bed showing, between vanilla WaterShallow (depth 2) and Mud (just exposed). A plain tiled terrain picture like vanilla Marsh (no waterDepthShader), so the bed shows. Nothing is installed: The IN GAME column is the placeholder (vanilla WaterShallow, the deeper neighbour); the scale panels sit on vanilla Mud (the drier neighbour). Pick the render column to approve it, or reject and depth 1 falls back to WaterShallow.

Vanilla water's look is an offline approximation (it draws through a shader from a 64 px ramp). Texture repeat is shown at 8 cells per 1024 px (unmeasured). The drying-pond strip, deep to dry, is drying_pond_strip.png beside this sheet's work folder: D:\Luke\dev\RimMandrake\Transient\water_thin_2026-10-16\work\drying_pond_strip.png
